IPT.evidence_source: [/page/2/Text/12] CWD-A Condition. The CWD-A course is a group intervention that combines cognitive and behavioral strategies aimed at ameliorating the types of problems that commonly characterize depressed adolescents. The treatment incorporates other elements shared by [/page/2/Text/13] CBT, such as the focus on specific and current actions and cognitions as targets for change, structured intervention sessions, repeated practice of skills, use of rewards and contracts, homework assignments, and a relatively small number of therapy sessions. ... [/page/2/Text/14] LS Condition. The LS intervention consisted of current events review, life skills training (e.g., filling out a job application, renting an apartment), and academic tutoring.
IPT.warning: The paper describes two interventions: CWD-A (CBT) and LS (Life Skills). Since LS is not IPT, and the MA coding rule states 'otherwise (CBT-flavored, problem-solving, BA, etc.) → 0', both arms are coded as 0. This is not the dual-arm CBT vs IPT exception, so a single record is emitted.
